title: Hostinger AI Builder Review 2026: Pricing, Features, and Honest Verdict
summary: Hostinger AI Builder is cheap and fast, but it falls short on renewal pricing, AI credit depth, and backend capability. Here's why Blink is the more complete platform for serious builders.
body_markdown: Blink.
